blocks.text: This chapter is a major turning point in First Kings. The story has moved through Solomon’s wisdom, temple building, and rule; here his failure introduces the coming division of the kingdom and the conflicts that shape the rest of the book.

The judgment announced in verses 9–13 explains why the kingdom will later be divided, but it does not present that division as happening through one cause alone. First Kings also portrays later human political choices—especially those involving Rehoboam, Jeroboam, and their counselors—as part of how the announced division unfolds.
